ui.teamBridge.alerts.severity.role: badge on an alert card and severity toggle

placeholders.worst: `yes` or `no`; selects the arm. Never shown.

ui.teamBridge.alerts.severity.note: SEV1..SEV4 is the on-call severity scale; keep the literal `SEV` prefix and the digit. `worst=yes` is on a group card that bundles several alerts and shows the most severe one.

ui.teamBridge.alerts.severity_unknown.note: The monitoring tool sent a severity this app cannot map.

ui.teamBridge.alerts.status.note: State of the monitored incident reported by the monitoring tool (Datadog, Grafana). Firing = the alert condition is active.

ui.teamBridge.alerts.test_badge.note: Marks a sample alert sent to test the integration; it wakes nobody.

ui.teamBridge.alerts.group_count.role: meta text on a group alert card

placeholders.resolved: how many of them have resolved

ui.teamBridge.alerts.group_count.note: A group card bundles a burst of alerts from one app. Reads like '6 alerts, 2 resolved'.

ui.teamBridge.alerts.fire_count.note: How many times the monitoring tool re-sent this alert while it stayed active.

ui.teamBridge.alerts.last_fired.note: Lower case: follows a separator in one line, e.g. 'Fired 3 times · last 14:12'.

ui.teamBridge.alerts.more_labels.note: Count of label chips hidden for space; full list in the tooltip.

ui.teamBridge.alerts.fingerprint.role: monospace id on an alert card
ui.teamBridge.alerts.fingerprint.note: Short identifier of the incident, so people can match it in the monitoring tool. Keep `id` short.

placeholders.host: a hostname such as app.datadoghq.com, never translated

ui.teamBridge.alerts.open_on.note: Opens the alert in the monitoring tool. The host is shown so the reader knows where the link goes.

placeholders.label: link name from the monitoring tool, never translated

ui.teamBridge.alerts.open_labelled.note: Same as open_on, when the tool gave the link a name (e.g. 'Runbook on wiki.example.com').

ui.teamBridge.alerts.responders.role: small button on an alert card
ui.teamBridge.alerts.responders.note: Opens the dialog where you choose whether your own agent responds to alerts in this channel.

ui.teamBridge.alerts.review_ask.note: Your agent prepared a change and is waiting for your approval on this device; opens that question. 'Local Operator' is the product name, never translated.

ui.teamBridge.alerts.claim.unreported.note: The server has not reported whether any agent has taken this alert. Must not claim nobody has.

ui.teamBridge.alerts.claim.unclaimed.note: No agent has taken responsibility for this alert yet.

ui.teamBridge.alerts.claim.resolved_uncl.note: The alert recovered before any agent took it.

ui.teamBridge.alerts.claim.holder_for_ow.note: An agent acting for its owner, e.g. 'Aida for Ada'. Inserted into claim.taken_by.

ui.teamBridge.alerts.claim.holder_unknow.note: Used when the server did not name the agent. Inserted into claim.taken_by.

ui.teamBridge.alerts.claim.taken_by.note: Who is working on the alert. waiting = the agent asked its owner to approve an action; escalated = the server escalated it because nobody acted in time.

ui.teamBridge.alerts.responder.menu.role: menu item in a channel's menu
ui.teamBridge.alerts.responder.menu.note: Opens the responder dialog. Keep the ellipsis (locale ellipsis character).

placeholders.channel: channel name, never translated; keep the # before it

ui.teamBridge.alerts.responder.descripti.note: Each alert starts a new agent session; model usage is billed to the reader's own account.

ui.teamBridge.alerts.responder.read_only.note: Honest statement that saving is not possible in this version and the agent is NOT responding. Keep it plain, not apologetic.

ui.teamBridge.alerts.responder.tier_labe.role: group label over four option cards

ui.teamBridge.alerts.responder.tier_name.note: Autonomy levels for the agent. Canonical names from the product RFC; keep them short.

ui.teamBridge.alerts.responder.tier_deta.note: One sentence each, describing what the agent may do at that level. 'v1' means the first version of the feature.

ui.teamBridge.alerts.responder.severity_.note: Which alert severities wake the agent.

ui.teamBridge.alerts.apps.menu.role: menu item in a channel's menu
ui.teamBridge.alerts.apps.menu.note: Opens the Radient console page where organization admins add monitoring apps (Datadog, Grafana) to channels. Keep the ellipsis.
